page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its massive bundled local storage capacity, offering 94,489 GB of HDD storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, enabling substantial throughput for data-intensive operations. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, making it a practical choice for workloads requiring massive local capacity without the premium cost of solid-state drives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, big data analytics, and distributed file systems that require high-capacity local HDD storage.
